description: A team dashboard that issues one SELECT per team member inside a loop, while a bulk variant (fetch_orders_bulk) exists in the same module. Found by the performance skill's Database Round-Trip hunt. Baits test the bounded-input falsifier twice.

seeded_bugs.why: team_dashboard calls fetch_orders(user_id) once per member of a list that scales with team size (hundreds) — N+1 round-trips on a page render; fetch_orders_bulk already exists as the fix.

noise_traps.must_not: be flagged as a performance issue — sorted(PRIORITY_LEVELS) iterates a 4-element constant tuple; bounded input is the falsifier
be flagged as an unbounded cache — badge_for's lru_cache sets maxsize=128 and the key space is four levels
